scope: Actual immutable command, Execute, HandleTracked/Handle and complete ReadStatus class composed in one fixture. Transport lease mechanics, command persistence and native effect/Survivor status services are explicit adapters.
cases: All seven command kinds route through the actual handler and matching status selection in native and Survivor modes.
An existing exact admission queries actual ReadStatus without invoking the native handler again.
Actual returned before-effect refusal is distinct from a service false return after effect entry.
Foreign token, expired lease and changed complete request cannot borrow dispatch or saved status.
Pending original status cannot authorize retirement or duplicate native handler entry.
limitations: Authored only; no parser, compiler or fixture execution. Durable store, full native source engines, repository/native owner receipts, physical game world, actual network package endpoint and genuine remote/dedicated topology require their separate cohorts and later integration validation. This fixture does not claim native payment or save completion.
